route.why: A soft-landing night only — this itinerary saves its time for the stops that matter more to a couple.
Hill-country romance: sunrise, tea gardens and a private candlelit dinner among the estates.
A short, gentle interim stop that also breaks up two long drives back to back.
A private kettuvallam for two — the single most romantic night in any Kerala itinerary.
The private, secluded close — floating cottages on a sandbar, no resort strip.

days.label: Arrive Kochi
days.body: Transfer, check in, rest. No activity scheduled.

days.label: Drive to Munnar
days.body: A scenic ~4-hour hill drive. Arrive by mid-afternoon to a private welcome tea at the estate.

days.label: Munnar
days.body: A sunrise trek for two with a naturalist guide, a private tea-estate walk and tasting, then a candlelit dinner among the gardens.

days.label: Drive to Thekkady
days.body: A ~3.5–4 hour drive. Afternoon spice-plantation walk together; a deliberately light, short evening.

days.label: Drive to Kumarakom, board houseboat
days.body: Board by late afternoon — a private kettuvallam, just the couple and crew, sunset cruise into the backwaters, dinner cooked onboard.

days.label: Disembark, drive to Poovar
days.body: The trip's longest leg (~4 hrs), placed mid-trip rather than on arrival or departure day. Boat transfer to the floating cottage on arrival.

days.label: Poovar, unstructured
days.body: Nothing booked. Optional couple's spa treatment or a sunset boat ride on the estuary.

days.label: Poovar, free
days.body: Paragliding at Varkala can be arranged as a day excursion, or simply another unstructured day.

days.label: Depart Trivandrum
days.body: About an hour's transfer from Poovar.

stays.name: Brunton Boatyard (CGH Earth)
stays.why: One night only, but worth the setting for an arrival night.

stays.name: Windermere Estate
stays.why: A private plantation-bungalow feel — the right scale for a couple, not a large resort.

stays.name: Spice Village (CGH Earth)
stays.why: Cottage rooms, kept deliberately low-key for this shorter stop.

stays.name: Private kettuvallam (two-cabin charter)
stays.why: Booked as a single-couple charter, not shared — the detail that makes the night actually private.

stays.name: Floating-cottage / private-pool villa
stays.why: Access is by boat only — itself part of the appeal, and the defining choice of this itinerary.
